title: uv.lock update workflow: add team-review label after PR creation, not in the create call, to reduce duplicate Protect runs
answers: Why does the automated uv.lock update PR get a duplicate or canceled Protect run?
Where is the uv.lock auto-update PR created, labeled, and auto-merged?
How do I change the labels or auto-merge settings on the bot-created uv.lock PR?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/uv.yml (the uv.lock update job) creates a new branch and opens a PR for the refreshed uv.lock when no open update PR exists; it then enables squash auto-merge. Existing-PR updates and protect.yml are not touched by this path.
Rule: Create the uv.lock PR without `--label team-review`, then run `sleep 5` and `gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --add-label team-review` before `gh pr merge --auto --squash`. Keep the label step after creation and before auto-merge so the squash auto-merge is still set on the labeled PR.
Symptom: Back-to-back PR creation and labeling started a Protect run that was canceled by a second run, leaving a duplicate or rerun-needed check on the automated uv.lock PR.
Constraints: The five-second delay only reduces the race; it does not guarantee Protect avoids cancellation if scheduling is delayed. Do not expect this to fix other label or concurrency problems, and do not apply it to the existing-PR update branch, which this change leaves as is.
applies: Applies to the uv.lock auto-update job in .github/workflows/uv.yml; not a general rule for other bot PRs or for protect.yml concurrency.
says: Automated lockfile update pull requests get duplicate or canceled protection checks.
Stop dependency update bots from triggering redundant validation runs on new pull requests.
The automated dependency refresh pull request requires manual rerun because checks were canceled.
Separate team review labeling from pull request creation to prevent conflicting automated checks.
Lockfile update pull requests show duplicate status checks immediately after being opened.
search: The automated uv.lock update workflow in .github/workflows/uv.yml creates a PR without --label team-review, waits five seconds with sleep 5, and adds the label via gh pr edit before running gh pr merge --auto --squash to reduce duplicate or canceled Protect runs. This sequence applies when opening a new branch and PR for a refreshed uv.lock when no open PR exists. It does not apply to existing-PR updates, general bot PRs, or concurrency configuration in protect.yml.
